title: The African Woman is Rhythmic and Soulful: An Investigation of Implicit Biases in LLM Open-ended Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through an adapted LLM Implicit Association Test (IAT) comparing male and female names with career and family terms, decision-making tasks allocating leadership roles to generated male/female profiles, and qualitative thematic analysis of open-ended word generation and storytelling for gendered tropes.

Measured using an LLM IAT associating White and Black names with positive and negative valence, alongside qualitative thematic analysis of word clouds and open-ended story generation to identify cultural exoticization and stereotyping (e.g., prompting for an 'African woman' or 'Chinese girl').
Assessed via an adapted LLM IAT that compares associations between Muslim names versus 'other' names with positive and negative valence words.
